description: Ink-blind VC3D/m7 local surface growth envelope. Same growth bounds as v1, extended to cover every option vc_grow_seg_from_seed accepts; the resume group applies only when the plan names a surface to resume from.

inpaint.note: fill detected holes; changes the surface, so it is off by default

skip_overlap_check.note: skip the post-trace overlap check against other surfaces

resume_generations.note: resumed grows only; overrides the JSON generations

change_rationale: v1 bounded four parameters and the binary takes twelve, so inpainting, the overlap check and the whole resume path were unreachable from the fleet. v1 is left byte-identical because PLN-EXP-20260722-SEG-HYBRID-scrollfiesta-vc3d-r01-SOURCE_LOCK.json binds its sha256; a plan that wants the new options names v2.
